source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use md5sum to check FW files

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES but content is for an unrelated BIOS menu inventory and omits checksum comparison.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE / CHANGED; restores complete MD5 comparison and adds release identity, file-set and stronger-integrity evidence.

original_test_intent: Compute MD5 for every in-scope firmware file and compare each value with the matching authoritative release-note entry without altering the package.
original_method: Bind the package and release note to the same release, enumerate the approved file set safely, calculate MD5 read-only, compare expected versus actual deterministically, and report missing, extra, unreadable or mismatched artifacts.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the exact package and authoritative expected values. Hashing, comparison and evidence are entirely machine-executable; engineer review of the report is not part of automation capability.
required_inputs: Matching original release note or manifest
Complete in-scope file list and authoritative MD5 values
Rules for symlinks, duplicate basenames, extras and path normalization
Optional vendor signature or SHA-256 source for stronger assurance
safety_requirements: Hash read-only and never rename, normalize, unpack over, or modify the tested files during comparison.
Fail closed on missing/extra/duplicate/unreadable files, algorithm mismatch or release-identity ambiguity.
Treat MD5 equality only as compliance with the source release-note value, not proof of authenticity.
Do not flash or approve a partial file set.
Preserve exact expected/actual values and utility/version evidence.
agent_execution_scope: Validate release identity and enumerate the exact approved file set.
Compute MD5 for every target and optional SHA-256/signature evidence without mutation.
Produce deterministic expected/actual comparison and Tool Result.
engineer_actions: Supply/approve the authoritative release note and file scope.
Resolve any mismatch or provenance ambiguity and replace/quarantine the package as needed.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No fit: lscpu/dmidecode/lsblk/lspci neither hash firmware nor compare the release note.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain `md5sum` as required by the source; add SHA-256 or vendor-signature verification only as supplemental evidence, never as a silent substitute.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: MD5 algorithm, release-note comparison, script URL and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: MD5 RETAINED; STRONGER INTEGRITY EVIDENCE ADDITIVE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a deterministic manifest containing relative path, size, expected/actual MD5 and optional SHA-256/signature status for the complete approved file set.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Any host with read-only access to the exact firmware package and matching manifest.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record checksum utility version, OS and document/parser versions plus artifact hashes.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: The source release note is authoritative for MD5; vendor signature/checksum documentation applies when supplied.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds full-set and release-identity validation and stronger optional integrity signals while retaining required MD5.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Authoritative file list and expected values.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: MD5 is collision-weak and should not be represented as modern authenticity proof.

project_override_considerations: Projects may add SHA-256/signature checks or narrow an explicitly approved file set, but must still report source MD5 results for every in-scope file.
expected_evidence: Package/release-note hashes and matching release identity
Complete file list with relative paths, sizes and duplicate/symlink handling
Per-file expected/actual MD5 and return status
Optional SHA-256/signature results clearly labeled additive
Final complete-set Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Procedure and Criteria consistently require MD5 comparison with the release note. DeepSeek's unrelated content is a historical-review defect, not a master-source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation is clear. Missing package/manifest values are readiness inputs, not a permanent block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects unrelated hardware enumeration and restores the exact checksum task.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with FULLY AUTOMATABLE and retains its complete-set, provenance and stronger-hash safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps MD5 source coverage and separates automated Tool Result from engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents false package approval from an unrelated command or a partial file list and accurately bounds what an MD5 match proves.
independent_technical_reasoning: Hashing and exact value comparison are deterministic read-only operations. Required artifacts can be supplied as inputs without human participation in core execution.
